body.text: Card rows share one CSS contract — repeat(auto-fit, minmax(min(100%, var(--card-min)), 1fr)) — with each family setting --card-min; the per-family column counts and their breakpoints (.steps-grid[data-cols], .split-list[data-count], .grid-3/4 tablet rules, .stats-row phone rule) are deleted, so a new family needs a token, not a media query
